items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: The interviewee mentions Louis Armstrong only in response to the interviewer's prompt ('I know you talked about doing Armstrong') and does not describe any personal interaction, collaboration, or mentorship with him.

ctx.x: No, in fact, I never had a chance to listen to them because most of the time when they were working, we were working at the same time. So we couldn't get to each other that way, you see. And when he came back home, well, he worked it in a way he could get a job or, if he got a job, he just hired some fellas, you know. Stayed there.

Anything else about his funeral? And you say there were two bands for his funeral. That's right. Eureka and your band. That's right. Louis Armstrong, I didn't know what to say. He was a ball player. He was a ball player. He didn't play anything.
No, he didn't play nothing. He just split the body.
